description: Re-quotes and returns ONE unsigned XRP Ledger Payment to THORChain that the caller signs and submits with its own wallet. Same checks as swap.botgraph.org: OFAC screen on both addresses, minimum enforced, memo in MemoData only, no DestinationTag, LastLedgerSequence before the quote expiry. We never sign, submit or hold funds.

amount_xrp.description: XRP to send, e.g. "20" (up to 6 decimals). Must be at least the quote's minimum_xrp.

destination.description: Address that receives the coins: a Bitcoin address for BTC, an Ethereum 0x address for ETH or USDC.

from.description: The XRP account (r...) that will sign and pay.

to.description: What to receive: BTC (Bitcoin), ETH (Ether) or USDC (USDC on Ethereum).

name: build_swap_tx
title: Build the unsigned XRP Payment
